comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This pet can only be obtained from the following item: Papaya Starter Pack Lv50

However, the deed can be traded/sold and so they are quite easy to obtain on Maris server. Further info:

Quarters Rank: R1
Accepted Food: Cut Vegetables
Favorite Food: Mixed Pet Food (Vegetables)
Skills:

R1 Pet Training / 20 Intimacy - Scare
R4 Pet Training / 80 Intimacy - Fish Searching
R8 Pet Training / 150 Intmacy - Area search (land)

Pointless Trivia Note: it was originally given as a reward for UWO players in Japan for purchasing the game to play on PS3, and later became a 'Voyager Achievement Benefit' at 65 points. The more you know, as the saying goes. Cheers.

Source/pics: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Pet
